title: Noor and the Witness
author: Wendell Whitlock
blurb: Ansel Okonkwo, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, has spent three years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the statute expires.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
